description: This file contains utility functions for geometric calculations and spatial relationships of elements within a drawing or diagram, including bounding box computations, overlap detection, and element containment checks.

methods.name: getNonLinearElementRelativePoints
methods.description: Calculates vertices relative to the top-left position for non-linear elements, with special handling for diamond shapes.

methods.name: getElementRelativePoints
methods.description: Retrieves the vertices of an element relative to its top-left corner, handling linear and free-draw elements.

methods.name: getMinMaxPoints
methods.description: Computes the minimum and maximum x and y coordinates from a set of points, along with the center point.

methods.name: getRotatedBBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of an element after applying rotation.
